name: AbuseIPDB - Blacklist Geographic Threat Distribution
description: Analyzes the geographic distribution of blacklisted IPs to identify countries with the highest concentration of abusive IP addresses. Useful for threat landscape awareness and geo-blocking decisions.
query:
AbuseIPDB_Blacklist_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| summarize
    TotalIPs = dcount(IpAddress),
    AvgConfidenceScore = round(avg(AbuseConfidenceScore), 1),
    MaxConfidenceScore = max(AbuseConfidenceScore),
    HighConfidenceCount = countif(AbuseConfidenceScore >= 90),
    CriticalCount = countif(AbuseConfidenceScore == 100)
    by CountryCode
| extend HighConfidencePct = round(100.0 * HighConfidenceCount / TotalIPs, 1)
| order by TotalIPs desc
| take 30
